- "Null specification causes NullPointerException": call with null path and they expect NPE. But detectVersionFromPath(null) may NPE. We'll not mock it; call will cause NPE, assertThrows.

- "Invalid Path throws IllegalArgumentException": path string malformed ':::invalid_path:::'. We can have mockStatic where detectVersionFromPath throws IllegalArgumentException when called with that Path. Then detectVersion should propagate. So we mock.

- "detectOptionalVersion throws RuntimeException": we mock detectOptionalVersion to throw RuntimeException.

Also there is case where both detections empty default null version -> expected null.
